newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil extends gains, but closes off highs.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil extends gains, but closes off highs.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Jly (3rd pos) 1,271 rgt/tonne Apr (south) 1,355
Open/Hi/Low 1,275/1,282/1,270 Prev close 1,350 *
Prev settlement 1,270 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices closed off the highs on late profit-taking and heavy selling amid uncertainty ahead of the 1997/1998 palm and laurics oils outlook forum on Saturday. Trading was fairly active with speculative buying and covering seen earlier due to soyoil gains. July futures seen trading in 1,260-1,280 range on Friday.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Also firmed in widespread dealing.
"Profit-taking set in as people decided to take some profits at the higher levels amid uncertainty about this weekend's palm oil forum," a trader said.
The Kuala Lumpur Commodity Exchange is holding its 1997/1998 Palm and Laurics Oils Price Outlook Forum on Saturday.
Prices were likely to trade in narrow range on Friday as most traders were making their way to Kuala Lumpur for the forum, traders said.
The market is also waiting for the April 1-25 export data due on Friday, they said.
Traders said news that China's imports of vegetable oils are seen rising 25 percent to 3.8 million tonnes in 1996/1997 because of lower domestic oilseeds production had little impact on the market.
Earlier rise was helped by soyoil gains overnight and continued firmness in the cash market.
Trading was fairly active and turnover was at 1,849 lots.
Physicals April (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,355 ringgit against bids of 1,350 after trading from 1,350 to 1,355.
April (central) saw offers at 1,335 against bids at 1,325 with earlier trades done at 1,335 and 1,330.
May (south) was offered at 1,355 and bids at 1,350 with trades done at 1,352.50 and 1,350. May (central) saw offers at 1,335 and bids at 1,325.
Among refined products, last-half May RBD palm oil was offered at $570, June at $557.50 and July/Aug/Sep at $547.50. May was traded at $565 and $567.50, and June at $555.
Last-half May RBD palm olein saw offers at $600, June at $590, July at $582.50 and July/Aug/Sep at $575. June was traded at $592.50 and July/Aug/Sep at $575 and $577.50.
May RBD palm stearin was offered at $435 and June at $430. May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $285.
